hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a custom 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swap curve via beforeSwap: takes input from the pool manager, calls phiEth.deposit or phiEth.withdraw to convert, then settles the output — bypassing AMM liquidity entirely for a zero-fee, zero-slippage wrap/unwrap. Direct liquidity addition is blocked, and only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee may use this hook.
